summary: Implemented `rotate` in logkeep/rotate.py (wired into cli.py) per docs/rotate.md and policy.md; unit tests pass and a run on a copy of /app/data behaves as expected. One deviation: for a dated archive on a day that already has some, I use highest existing K + 1, because tests/test_rotate.py requires that; rotate.md says the lowest unused K from 2, which differs only when there is a gap.
